Independence Day: 3 night minimum ... Labor Day: 3 night minimum'; '14 days maximum consecutive stay rule: A guest may reserve and occupy a campsite for up to 14 consecutive nights within a single campground. campitks.gov site list (437 results: 6 cabins, 272 primitive, 4 shelters, 23 full hookup, 132 water/electric) and every site's campsiteDetails.page (211 site records, GIS coordinates, Maximum Vehicle Length, hookups, Proximity to Water, site Notes), read 2026-11-06. Bluffton utility loops: Arapaho 20 W/E 50 A (concrete; 051-052 long-term); Butterfield 16 ('Campsites 101-110 ... water, electricity and sewer. 111-116 ... water and electricity. Camphosts are located in Sites 101 & 102. Seasonal Campsites (available to rent monthly) are in sites 103-106'); Overland 30 ('Site 201 ... reserved for the Bluffton Area Camp Host', 'sites 202-230 are water and 50 AMP electric sites'); Wagon Rut 30 W/E (24 at 30/20 A, 6 at 50 A; 156 and 163 long-term); Hoonii 301-305 full hookup ('designated as a long term campsite ... open on a first come, first served basis when not reserved on a long term basis'); Despatch 251-256 full hookup; Broken Spur group camp ('reservable through the park office only ... 12, two utility campsites'). 'Proximity to Water: Within 1/4 Mile' and 'River/Lake View: Y' on every Bluffton site; none tagged lakefront.

Esri World Imagery with the booking site's per-site coordinates (38.8070,-99.7360 at 700 m; 38.8040,-99.7380 at 300 m), 2026-11-06: the nearest utility sites (Overland 224-227) sit ~100-120 m from the water across the boat-ramp road, parking lot and a wide bare-sand apron; Arapaho, Butterfield, Wagon Rut and Broken Spur are 300 m+ inland on the grass bench. Stored pin (38.8042,-99.7340) sits between Arapaho and Overland, ~200 m from the utility-site centroid.

min_stay.season: Memorial Day, Independence Day and Labor Day weekends (2027 rule)

values.note: Reserved on Kansas's ReserveAmerica site (campitks.gov). 2027 holiday minimum: 3 nights over Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends (Friday-Sunday or Saturday-Monday). Up to 14 consecutive nights in one campground, then move to another campground in the park; a 14-day extension needs the park manager's written permission, and a five-day absence is required before camping again. The Broken Spur group camp books through the park office only; several sites are held as long-term or monthly seasonal sites and are first-come when not let. Off-season the grid shows every site as walk-up.

values.note: 119 designated utility sites in the Bluffton Area: Arapaho 20, Butterfield 16, Overland 30, Wagon Rut 30, Hoonii 5, Despatch 6 and the 12-site Broken Spur group camp. note: Main north-shore area of Cedar Bluff Reservoir (Bureau of Reclamation lake run by KDWP as a state park): utility loops Arapaho, Butterfield, Overland, Wagon Rut, Hoonii and Despatch, the Broken Spur group camp, open primitive areas, five cabins, two boat ramps and a swim beach. The reservoir runs low: the nearest utility sites are ~100 m from the water across the ramp lot and a wide sand apron. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable (ReserveAmerica, now at campitks.gov), showers, dump. Added 50 A / water / sewer (22 full-hookup sites), 119 designated utility sites, pull-throughs to 180 ft, 2027 holiday 3-night minimums, 14-night rule, flush toilets, drinking water, open year round. Fees left as recorded (Nov 1, 2026 statewide schedule, AWH 2026-10-15). Lakeview confirmed: every site tagged 'Within 1/4 Mile' + lake view, none lakefront; nearest utility pads ~100 m back across a road, lot and sand.
